trust_decision.summary: ADVISORY/FIX MISMATCH: the advisory says CWE-79 registration-name XSS, but the listed fix commit ('Participants count not checked when assigning members to events #2143') enforces the event participant limit. Role::startMembership decides whether a new member fits under rol_max_members. Event participation roles never get rol_max_members, because Role::setValue refuses non-empty values for event roles, so the generic role-assignment route ignores the event's dat_max_members.

landing_point.why: Judged from the fix commit title (members assigned to events beyond the participant count), because the advisory text names a registration-name XSS that no changed file touches. This is the generic role member-assignment AJAX handler that calls Role::startMembership.

fix_sites.entry_point: Event::save(), reached from events_function.php:327 and every other event save
Role::setMaxMembersFromEvent(), a public API that bypasses the Role::setValue guard at src/Roles/Entity/Role.php:780-782

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/Events/Entity/Event.php:391-400 together with src/Roles/Entity/Role.php:780-782. The fix makes Event::save the producer of the role's rol_max_members, because the Role::setValue guard silently drops the value on every save.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The setValue guard at src/Roles/Entity/Role.php:780-782 deliberately makes event-role date and limit columns read-only, so a solver can argue that the event module owns the limit and that only the handler needs a check, leaving the role data and the other startMembership/setMembership callers alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Existing participants and leaders must still be re-assignable and promotable, and leader-flag changes must still work when the limit is reached. The fix skips the check when the user is already a member. Unlimited roles (rol_max_members 0/NULL) must stay unlimited, and the event creator's self-assignment as leader runs through the same Role::startMembership.

O6_input_shapes: new event (role created, src/Roles/Entity/Role.php:780 guard drops the limit)
copied event (events_function.php:288-296 setNewRecord on a copied role)
member assignment vs leader assignment (memberFlag / leaderFlag, members_assignment.php:58-68)

O7_producer.where: src/Roles/Entity/Role.php:774-783 (setValue override that discards rol_max_members for event roles); the fixed producer is src/Events/Entity/Event.php:391-400

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Profile role-assignment page auto-assigns the role stored in session set_rol_id (set by viewing an event role's member-assignment page) through Role::startMembership with no event-limit check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only reached after creating a new contact from the assignment page. It looks like a convenience flow in the profile module, not member assignment.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other module (modules/profile) from the landing point; session set at modules/groups-roles/members_assignment.php:80

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Membership date edit (save_membership) calls Role::setMembership with forcePeriod, which can re-activate an ended event-role membership without any max-members check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It edits dates of an existing membership rather than adding one, so it looks out of scope.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Event participation roles that existed before the fix keep rol_max_members NULL until the event is re-saved, so Role::startMembership stays unlimited for them (no DB update script in the fix)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Data migration looks like an ops concern, not code, and the fix syncs on the next save.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Default-registration role assignment via Role::startMembership; an event role flagged rol_default_registration would bypass the event limit
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same generic startMembership loop that a maintainer would not associate with events.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Parent-role propagation starts membership in dependent roles without an event-limit check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Role dependencies are a separate feature, and propagation is written for group roles.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: CSV import assigns the selected role via startMembership; import.php:171 filters out EVENTS but import_read_file.php:72-81 accepts any role UUID
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The filter lives only in the UI select list, so a server-side sibling is plausible.

O9_family: business-logic / authorization: limit not enforced (missing check across entry points); NOT CWE-79 as the advisory states

O10_build.project_tests: None in the pinned tree (no tests/ directory found); behavioural tests would need an HTTP harness with an installed DB.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a participantLimitReached() check only in members_assignment.php, leaving the role's rol_max_members unset because Role::setValue drops it.

out_of_scope_notes: The advisory summary (unauthenticated stored XSS via registration name, CWE-79) does not match the listed fix commit, which touches no output/escaping code and no registration code.
events_function.php:448 guest-count comparison uses '<' and may be off by one versus participantLimitReached's '<='; not pursued.
